questions: Is the assessment domain restricted so that any existing tokenised product assessed for materialchange is SFC-authorised? Otherwise, the supplied inputs cannot distinguish an authorised product from an unauthorised one.
Before which implementation or application milestone must consultation occur?
What does footnote 8 provide concerning prior approval?

Can the restricted assessment domain be confirmed? Without it, this formula can overstate consultation requirements for material changes to unauthorised products, and the fixed interface cannot express the missing qualification.
